name: codex-agy-plugin
description: Antigravity CLI (agy) integration for OpenAI Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate prompts and code review from Codex to Antigravity CLI.
interface.longDescription: Codex Agy lets Codex call the local Antigravity CLI (agy) for second opinions, code review, planning, and delegated analysis.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Antigravity CLI to review the current task without modifying files.
